localDatabase.automaticBackup: Local systemd timer: two minutes after WSL boot, then hourly while WSL runs; no cloud resource
localDatabase.retention: Keep all complete dumps for 14 days and at least the newest seven; mode 0700 directories / 0600 dump files
localDatabase.restoreVerification: Actual custom-format pg_dump restored into a new isolated database. New article, 4 private evidence checkpoints, tokens, usage, reservation and PAUSED state verified.

maintenance.restoreSafety: Run from the PR worktree. Restore creates a new isolated database, never overwrites an existing one, and forces PAUSED. Do not switch runtime to an older dump without reconciling newer reservations; never restore into Production.

accounting.historicalEvidence: Reported prior evidence, NOT recovered database transactions
accounting.hardStopTest: Rolled-back synthetic test accepted $0.92 of new reservations and rejected the next reservation; original $0.08 remained unavailable.
accounting.credentials: Ignored local environment file, presence verified inside actual process; no values in reports, Git or backups

dimayor.publicChecks: All three HTTP 200, source attribution and homepage links verified
dimayor.startupDefect: Sources initially received a due timestamp after the cycle clock. Fixed initialization to use the same explicit clock; added regression test.
dimayor.recovery: Initial cycle made zero model/source calls. A single audited local continuation reused its existing reservation. No budget reset or new reservation; temporary recovery route removed and verified HTTP 404.
dimayor.unattendedLimit: This is a controlled local scheduler-pipeline validation, not proof of repeated daily autonomous publication.
